title: damanithesun drop a new song "TOXIC"
htmlContent:
damanithesun shares a catchy single called "TOXIC". Heavy song about a toxic relationship, melodic flows throughout and a very deep and lyrical hook that ketches your attention and is hard to forget. He sings with so much soul, that you wonder how he knows you need to hear this song, in this moment. The production embodies acoustic indie vibes, with amazing songwriting that tells this story to perfection to make everything come together in a divine way.
